tools.name: page_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a web page by URL and return a structured page of clean, readable plain text with line counts and continuation metadata. HTML tags, scripts and styling are stripped out. Use start_line and end_line to continue through long pages. Not suitable for pages that require login or heavy JavaScript rendering to show content.

url.description: The full URL to fetch, including scheme, e.g. 'https://example.com/article'

start_line.description: First content line to return (1-based). Defaults to 1.

start_column.description: Character column within start_line (1-based). Defaults to 1. Pass the returned next_start_column when continuing within an unusually long line.

end_line.description: Last content line to return, inclusive. Defaults to 100 lines after start_line and is capped at 200 lines per call.
